requiredScope: The required scope in contract-v1.json remains in force. This record adds executable domains and excludes no existing obligation.

mysql.interpretation: Native grammar, default lexical settings, lower_case_table_names=0, utf8mb4 connection and result encodings, signed arithmetic, empty sql_mode.

postgres.interpretation: Native grammar, UTF-8, stock 63-byte name limit, standard_conforming_strings on. Analyzed unqualified integer operators use pg_catalog ahead of user schemas. Emitted operators denote the exact pg_catalog int4 signature.

Identifier.conditions: PostgreSQL: 1–63 UTF-8 bytes, excluding NUL. MySQL: 0–256 Unicode BMP characters excluding NUL, with object-name restrictions checked by TableSource.
Identifier.sql: PostgreSQL double quotes and MySQL backticks, doubling the delimiter.

IntegerLiteral.meaning: MySQL signed integer literal and PostgreSQL int4
IntegerLiteral.sql: Signed decimal. PostgreSQL explicitly casts to pg_catalog.int4.

BooleanLiteral.meaning: PostgreSQL boolean and MySQL signed 0 or 1

NullLiteral.meaning: MySQL NULL and PostgreSQL NULL of text type at the result boundary

ColumnReference.conditions: nonnegative slot, valid membership checked at SELECT construction
ColumnReference.meaning: signed INT in MySQL or int4 in PostgreSQL, including NULL values
ColumnReference.sql: qualified with the fixed source alias

ArithmeticOperator.meaning: MySQL signed BIGINT arithmetic or PostgreSQL pg_catalog int4 signature, with NULL propagation and engine overflow
ArithmeticOperator.sql: fixed operator symbol, schema-qualified in PostgreSQL

Arithmetic.conditions: ordered left and right operands, each an integer literal, column slot or arithmetic expression
Arithmetic.meaning: operator applied to its ordered children

ResultColumn.conditions: one of the closed expression roles and its exact output name

TableSource.role: external base table and interfaces to the referenced columns
TableSource.conditions: absolute schema and table, ordered unique column names under dialect identifier comparison; PostgreSQL also records inclusion or exclusion of descendants.
TableSource.meaning: external precondition to provide the named columns with the type defined by their slot role
TableSource.sql: schema-qualified table with fixed alias and PostgreSQL ONLY when selected

Select.conditions: 1–1024 results, zero or one source, every column slot in scope, depth at most 32 and at most 8192 expanded expression nodes
Select.meaning: one result row per input row, or one result row when no source is specified
Select.sql: SELECT with ordered results and the optional source

constructionPaths: Dialect-owned final value constructors with closed operand unions and copied array fields.
Dialect Semantics::ir() and Ir::Analyzer::analyze() with the fixed release and a supplied base table declaration when names must be resolved.
Native PHP clone, serialization, restoration and dynamic properties are blocked by the dialect Snapshot trait.
observations: no parameter slots or guaranteed row order in these domains
finiteDomain: For each engine and for no source and the fixed source, enumerate every allowed individual leaf and every ordered pair of integer atoms under each of +, -, *. For the PostgreSQL source, repeat with and without inheritance. Enumerate the actual structural IDs exactly once.

Q04: independent numeric semantics plus fixed server releases
